title: Changing the default rest or the rest-over sound is never tested
what: The only test of the Rest timer and sounds page opens it and looks for one row. No test changes the default rest, checks the next rest starts at the new time, picks a rest-over sound, checks a failed save keeps the sheet open, or checks the buzz-only line when workout sounds are off.
expected: A phone test changes the default rest to 2:00 and sees the next rest start at 2:00, picks a sound, and a small test covers the could-not-save and sounds-off lines.
fix_line: Add a phone test that changes the default rest and the rest sound and checks the next rest

title: The phone's Gym timings page is never opened in a test
what: Only the pieces that build the words (open now, the week, special days) and the server answer are tested. No test opens the Gym timings page on the phone: the loading line, today's mark, 'No timings yet', pull to refresh, the no-gym screen, the offline first open and the page turning closed at closing time are all unchecked.
expected: A phone test opens Gym timings for a test gym with hours, a note and a holiday, and for a gym with no hours, and checks what the member sees.
fix_line: Add a phone test that opens Gym timings with hours, with none, and offline

title: The light or dark switch is only photographed, never checked
what: The phone test that is said to prove 'Same as phone' follows the phone live only takes pictures; nothing checks the screen really turned dark. The chips test taps Dark and Light and then checks only that the caption is still there.
expected: The test checks something that differs between the looks (a colour sample or a light/dark marker) after each tap and after the phone switches with the app open.
fix_line: Make the look test check the screen colour after each change, not only take pictures

title: The widget start, its confirm screen and its retry are never shown in a test
what: Only the rule that decides start, resume, confirm or Workout tab is tested. No phone test taps the Today widget, opens a keyless link to see 'Start Push 1?' with 'Start Push 1' and 'Not now', double taps it, or sees 'Couldn't start' with Try again. Reopening after Android closed the app mid-workout is not tested either.
expected: A phone test opens a widget link and a keyless link for a real routine and checks one workout starts, the confirm screen, Not now and a failed start.
fix_line: Add a phone test for the widget start, the Start confirm screen and a failed start

title: Workout reminders: changing days or time, and the no-gym page, are never tested
what: The phone test switches workout reminders on and stops. No test removes a day or changes the time and checks the Next line and the set reminders follow, switches them off and on and checks the member's own days come back, or opens the page with no gym and checks the two gym rows are hidden.
expected: Tests change a day and the time and check the Next line and the set reminders, turn the switch off and on, and open the page with no gym.
fix_line: Add tests that change reminder days and time and open the page with no gym

title: Message your gym: failures and later states are checked only as words
what: The phone tests send good messages only. An empty message, the box stopping at 1000 letters, no internet keeping the typed text, too many today, seen, done with Write back, a full conversation, a fast double tap and taking a trainer question back are checked only as word tables or on the server, never on the page.
expected: A phone test covers an empty send, an offline send that keeps the text, a double tap that sends once, and seen and done replies on the page.
fix_line: Add phone test steps for empty, offline, double-tap and seen or done messages

title: The open-on-watch switch, the watch install message and the gym widget are never tested
what: No test checks the 'Open MettleUp on my watch' switch, so the watch could still open when it is off. The message after tapping Install on watch, a double tap, the 'Add Gym right now' button (only with a gym) and the placed-widget count are not tested either.
expected: Tests check the watch does not open with the switch off, the after-tap message, and the Widgets page with and without a gym and after a widget is placed.
fix_line: Add tests for the open-on-watch switch, the install message and the gym widget row
